response.sql: WITH regional AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END) AS average_signed_amount, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id WHERE t.date > '960509' AND t.date < '980106' GROUP BY d.A3), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_signed_amount) AS average_of_regional_averages FROM regional) SELECT r.region, r.average_signed_amount, r.transaction_count, r.average_signed_amount / o.average_of_regional_averages AS ratio FROM regional AS r CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.average_of_regional_averages IS NOT NULL

assumptions.assumption: Transaction dates are stored as YYMMDD text, as documented for other date columns; the format of trans.date is not specified.

alternatives.interpretation: If trans.date is stored as YYYY-MM-DD text, compare against dates in that format.
